title: SMS Backup & Restore
summary: The fastest secure data backup and restore tool on Android!
description:
With SMS Backup & Restore, text message recovery app, you will never lose your data again!

You found the solution, one app to Backup and Restore SMS, Contact backup, Call Logs & More!



You can backup and restore:
Text messages, Apps, Contacts, SMS, Call Logs, and Calendars to your Storage and Drive.

🔥The fast data backup and restore tool for Android - phone rescue! 🔥

⚡Phone Rescue - Contact backup and message recovery⚡
If you intend to do a factory reset on the phone, please make sure to back up your data on Storage and Drive. If not, please copy the entire backup folder ("AllBackupRestore" by default) to your phone's storage.

⚡Automatic Back Up⚡
If you schedule automatic backups and you use some apps such as Task Killer or Memory Clear, please make sure you add SMS Backup & Restore into Safelist on your phone. Otherwise, the recover deleted text messages app can not run in the background, and automatic contact backup and restore text messages will not work.

⚡SMS backup and restore - Recover deleted text messages⚡
When you finish with the SMS backup and restore process, if the messages are not displayed in your default SMS app, please try to reboot your device. Unique Recover deleted text messages backup and restore tool! Your restore text messages app.

With your phone rescue - text message recovery app, you can restore your backup onto the same or a new Android device.

The migrate feature allows you to move any supported content directly from one device to another over WiFi.

Phone rescue - message recovery easy backup features:
👉 Backup Apps to Storage or Drive - easily install apps from Storage or Drive,
👉 Fast and Easy my Contacts Backup - Restore Contacts,
👉 Fast and Easy SMS Backup and Restore -
Recover deleted text messages,
👉 Fast and Easy Backup of Call logs - Restore Call logs,
👉 Fast and Easy Backup of Calendar- Restore Calendar,
👉 Schedule automatic backups,
👉 Select a backup destination,
👉 Backup app - backup and restore automatic backup!

The SMS backup & restore app is called by many names, and these are some of them: phone rescue tool, Text message recovery, Restore text messages tool, my contact backup, easy backup tool, message recovery app, and many others.

You will never lose your data again!
